create_embedding_client: create an EmbeddingClient instance using the text-embedding-3-small OpenAI model
create_azure_embedding_client: create an EmbeddingClient instance using the azure-text-embedding-3-large Azure model
get_embedding_single: get the embedding vector for a single code string using EmbeddingClient
get_embedding_batch: get embedding vectors for a list of code strings using EmbeddingClient
check_embedding_cost: check the per-token embedding cost for text-embedding-3-small or text-embedding-3-large models
